package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"io/ioutil"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestHandlers(t *testing.T) {
	router := mux.NewRouter()
	router.HandleFunc("/todos", ListTodos).Methods("GET")
	router.HandleFunc("/todos/{id}", GetTodo).Methods("GET")
	router.HandleFunc("/todos", CreateTodo).Methods("POST")
	router.HandleFunc("/todos/{id}", UpdateTodo).Methods("PUT")
	router.HandleFunc("/todos/{id}", DeleteTodo).Methods("DELETE")

	t.Run("ListTodos", func(t *testing.T) {
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/todos", nil)
		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

		assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	})

	t.Run("GetTodo", func(t *testing.T) {
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/todos/1", nil)
		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

		assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	})

	t.Run("CreateTodo", func(t *testing.T) {
		payload := []byte(`{"title": "new todo"}`)
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "/todos", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

		assert.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, resp.Code)
	})

	t.Run("UpdateTodo", func(t *testing.T) {
		payload := []byte(`{"title": "updated todo"}`)
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("PUT", "/todos/1", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

		assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	})

	t.Run("DeleteTodo", func(t *testing.T) {
		req, _ := http.NewRequest("DELETE", "/todos/1", nil)
		resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

		assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	})
}

package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

type Todo struct {
	ID        int     `db:"id"`
	Title     string  `db:"title"`
	Completed bool    `db:"completed"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `db:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `db:"updated_at"`
}

func (t *Todo) Insert(db *sql.DB, title string) error {
	return db.QueryRow(`
	INSERT INTO todos (title, completed)
	VALUES ($1, $2)
	RETURNING id
	`, title, false).Scan(&t.ID)
}

func (t *Todo) Get(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	return db.Get(t, `
	SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
	FROM todos
	WHERE id = $1
	`, id)
}

func (t *Todo) Update(db *sql.DB, id int, title string, completed bool) error {
	return db.QueryRow(`
	UPDATE todos
	SET title = $2, completed = $3, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
	WHERE id = $1
	RETURNING id
	`, id, title, completed).Scan(&t.ID)
}

func (t *Todo) Delete(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	_, err := db.Exec(`
	DELETE FROM todos
	WHERE id = $1
	`, id)
	return err
}

func ListTodos(db *sql.DB) ([]Todo, error) {
	var todos []Todo
	err := db.Select(&todos, `
	SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
	FROM todos
	ORDER BY created_at
	`)
	return todos, err
}

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"

func TestGetTodos(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.Default()

	db.InitDB()
	todos := []*db.Todo{
		{Title: "Todo 1"},
		{Title: "Todo 2"},
	}
	for _, todo := range todos {
		err := todo.Insert(db.GetDB(), todo.Title)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}

	r.GET("/todos", GetTodos)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/todos", nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

	r.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	var todoList []db.Todo
	err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &todoList)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 2, len(todoList))
}

func TestGetTodo(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.Default()

	db.InitDB()
	todo := &db.Todo{Title: "Test Todo"}
	err := todo.Insert(db.GetDB(), todo.Title)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	r.GET("/todos/:id", GetTodo)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/todos/"+strconv.Itoa(todo.ID), nil)
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

	r.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	var retrievedTodo db.Todo
	err = json.Unmarshal(resp.Body.Bytes(), &retrievedTodo)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, todo.ID, retrievedTodo.ID)
}

func TestCreateTodo(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.Default()

	db.InitDB()
	r.POST("/todos", CreateTodo)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "/todos", strings.NewReader(`{"title":"Test Todo"}`))
	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()

	r.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

)

	flag.StringVar(&dbName, "db-name", "dbname", "Database name")
}

func main() {
	flag.Parse()

	dbUrl := dbHost + ":" + dbName
	connStr := "host=" + dbUser + " user=" + dbPass + " dbname=" + dbName
	var err error
	db.DB, err = gorm.Open("postgres", connStr)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to connect to database: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.DB.Close()

	r := gin.Default()
	r.GET("/todos", handlers.ListTodosHandler)
	r.GET("/todos/:id", handlers.GetTodoHandler)
	r.POST("/todos", handlers.CreateTodoHandler)
	r.PUT("/todos/:id", handlers.UpdateTodoHandler)
	r.DELETE("/todos/:id", handlers.DeleteTodoHandler)

	log.Printf("Listening on :%s", port)
	if err := r.Run(":" + port); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to start server: %v", err)
	}
}
